title: Episode About Kangar, Tapa and Dina Villages Mm

blocks.text: After Sarsa the Ropar Pathans open their doors and some wounded Singhs are treated, but the situation remains unstable and mercy is mixed with fear, exhaustion, and calculation. (8–11)
At the same time a Brahmin cook and other opportunists are drawn by jewels, goods, and rumor, and their greed begins to corrupt the fragile sanctuary built around the scattered family. (12–15)

One strand of that betrayal ends with the Guru's party being divided again while another leaves a remnant household, including Mata Gujri, increasingly exposed inside borrowed shelter. The Brahmin cook thus becomes one key agent of collapse. (16)
